CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS mes_exec_asset (
  asset_id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY,
  display_name VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
  site_code VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
  area_code VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
  asset_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
  status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
  source_name VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  freshness VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
  updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS mes_exec_sku (
  sku_code VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY,
  display_name VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
  uom VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL,
  quality_status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'released',
  freeze_minutes INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS mes_exec_resource (
  resource_id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY,
  resource_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
  site_code VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
  qty NUMERIC(14,3) NOT NULL,
  reserved_qty NUMERIC(14,3) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  uom VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL,
  data_status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
  quality_status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
  owner_role VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  freshness VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
  comment_text VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL DEFAULT ''
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS mes_exec_reserve (
  reserve_id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY,
  resource_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  pub_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  qty NUMERIC(14,3) NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS mes_exec_candidate (
  candidate_id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY,
  site_code VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
  sku_code VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  planned_qty NUMERIC(14,3) NOT NULL,
  uom VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL,
  quality_status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
  validation_status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
  validation_message VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  idempotency_key VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS mes_exec_snapshot (
  snapshot_id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY,
  pub_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  payload_json VARCHAR(4000) NOT NULL,
  payload_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS mes_exec_pub (
  pub_id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY,
  pub_version INTEGER NOT NULL,
  candidate_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  previous_pub_id VARCHAR(64),
  site_code VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
  sku_code VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  planned_qty NUMERIC(14,3) NOT NULL,
  uom VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL,
  status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
  shop_status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
  snapshot_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  reason_text VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  published_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS mes_exec_fact (
  fact_id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY,
  pub_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  sku_code VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  actual_qty NUMERIC(14,3) NOT NULL,
  delay_minutes INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  reason_code VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  recorded_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS mes_exec_deviation (
  deviation_id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY,
  pub_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  severity VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
  reason_code VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  delay_minutes INTEGER NOT NULL,
  status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS mes_exec_tail (
  tail_id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY,
  pub_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  sku_code VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  tail_qty NUMERIC(14,3) NOT NULL,
  uom VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL,
  reason_code VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  period_code VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
  idempotency_key VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS mes_exec_period_close (
  close_id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY,
  pub_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  period_code VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
  status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
  closed_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  UNIQUE (pub_id, period_code)
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS mes_exec_alert (
  alert_id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY,
  pub_id VARCHAR(64),
  site_code VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
  severity VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
  alert_type VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
  owner_role VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  message_text VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS mes_exec_inbox (
  message_id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY,
  message_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
  idempotency_key VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  payload_json VARCHAR(4000) NOT NULL,
  status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
  received_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS mes_exec_delivery (
  delivery_id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY,
  pub_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  recipient_code VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
  error_text VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  UNIQUE (pub_id, recipient_code)
);

{"steps":[{"type":"selectOne","var":"kpi","sql":"SELECT line_code, shift_label, CAST(ROUND(CASE WHEN planned_minutes > 0 THEN (planned_minutes - downtime_minutes) * 100.0 / planned_minutes ELSE 0 END, 0) AS INT) AS availability_pct, CAST(ROUND(CASE WHEN (planned_minutes - downtime_minutes) > 0 AND total_units > 0 THEN LEAST(100.0, ideal_cycle_sec * total_units * 100.0 / ((planned_minutes - downtime_minutes) * 60)) ELSE 0 END, 0) AS INT) AS performance_pct, CAST(ROUND(CASE WHEN total_units > 0 THEN good_units * 100.0 / total_units ELSE 0 END, 0) AS INT) AS quality_pct, CAST(ROUND(CASE WHEN planned_minutes > 0 AND total_units > 0 THEN (CASE WHEN planned_minutes > 0 THEN (planned_minutes - downtime_minutes) * 1.0 / planned_minutes ELSE 0 END) * (CASE WHEN (planned_minutes - downtime_minutes) > 0 AND total_units > 0 THEN LEAST(1.0, ideal_cycle_sec * total_units * 1.0 / ((planned_minutes - downtime_minutes) * 60)) ELSE 0 END) * (CASE WHEN total_units > 0 THEN good_units * 1.0 / total_units ELSE 0 END) * 100 ELSE 0 END, 0) AS INT) AS oee_pct FROM mes_oee_shift WHERE id = CAST(? AS uuid)","params":["${input.shiftId}"]},{"type":"failIfNull","var":"kpi","message":"Shift not found"},{"type":"return","fields":{"error_code":"OK","error_message":"","lineCode":"${kpi.line_code}","shiftLabel":"${kpi.shift_label}","availabilityPct":"${kpi.availability_pct}","performancePct":"${kpi.performance_pct}","qualityPct":"${kpi.quality_pct}","oeePct":"${kpi.oee_pct}"}}]}

{"steps":[{"type":"selectOne","var":"shift","sql":"SELECT id, downtime_minutes, planned_minutes FROM mes_oee_shift WHERE id = CAST(? AS uuid)","params":["${input.shiftId}"]},{"type":"failIfNull","var":"shift","message":"Shift not found"},{"type":"exec","sql":"UPDATE mes_oee_shift SET downtime_minutes = LEAST(planned_minutes, downtime_minutes + ?) WHERE id = CAST(? AS uuid)","params":["${input.minutes}","${input.shiftId}"]},{"type":"selectOne","var":"updated","sql":"SELECT downtime_minutes FROM mes_oee_shift WHERE id = CAST(? AS uuid)","params":["${input.shiftId}"]},{"type":"return","fields":{"error_code":"OK","error_message":"","downtimeMinutes":"${updated.downtime_minutes}"}}]}

{"steps":[{"type":"selectMany","var":"lines","sql":"SELECT line_code, display_name, area_path FROM mes_platform_line ORDER BY line_code"},{"type":"map","var":"rows","source":"${lines}","fields":{"lineCode":"${item.line_code}","displayName":"${item.display_name}","areaPath":"${item.area_path}"}},{"type":"return","fields":{"error_code":"OK","error_message":"","rows":"${rows}"}}]}
{"steps":[{"type":"return","fields":{"error_code":"OK","error_message":"","confirmed":true,"workOrderPath":"${input.workOrderPath}"}}]}

{"steps":[{"type":"selectMany","var":"samples","sql":"SELECT id::text AS sample_id, line_code, measurement_mm, sample_ts::text AS sample_ts FROM mes_spc_sample ORDER BY sample_ts DESC LIMIT 20"},{"type":"map","var":"rows","source":"${samples}","fields":{"sampleId":"${item.sample_id}","lineCode":"${item.line_code}","measurementMm":"${item.measurement_mm}","sampleTs":"${item.sample_ts}"}},{"type":"return","fields":{"error_code":"OK","error_message":"","rows":"${rows}"}}]}

{"steps":[{"type":"exec","sql":"UPDATE mes_batch_run SET phase = ?, batch_id = ?, recipe = COALESCE(NULLIF(?, ''), recipe), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE batch_path = ?","params":["${input.phase}","${input.batchId}","${input.recipe}","${input.batchPath}"]},{"type":"selectOne","var":"updated","sql":"SELECT batch_path FROM mes_batch_run WHERE batch_path = ?","params":["${input.batchPath}"]},{"type":"when","var":"updated","notNull":false,"then":[{"type":"exec","sql":"INSERT INTO mes_batch_run (batch_path, batch_id, recipe, phase) VALUES (?, ?, COALESCE(NULLIF(?, ''), 'default-recipe'), ?)","params":["${input.batchPath}","${input.batchId}","${input.recipe}","${input.phase}"]}]},{"type":"return","fields":{"error_code":"OK","error_message":"","batchPath":"${input.batchPath}","phase":"${input.phase}"}}]}

{"steps":[{"type":"exec","sql":"INSERT INTO mes_erp_outbox (id, entity_type, entity_id, payload_json, idempotency_key, status) SELECT RANDOM_UUID(), ?, ?, ?, CONCAT(?, ':', ?), 'pending' WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mes_erp_outbox WHERE idempotency_key = CONCAT(?, ':', ?))","params":["${input.entityType}","${input.entityId}","${input.payloadJson}","${input.entityType}","${input.entityId}","${input.entityType}","${input.entityId}"]},{"type":"selectOne","var":"keyRow","sql":"SELECT CONCAT(?, ':', ?) AS idempotency_key","params":["${input.entityType}","${input.entityId}"]},{"type":"return","fields":{"error_code":"OK","error_message":"","enqueued":true,"idempotencyKey":"${keyRow.idempotency_key}"}}]}

{"steps":[{"type":"selectMany","var":"pending","sql":"SELECT id::text AS outbox_id, entity_type, entity_id, idempotency_key FROM mes_erp_outbox WHERE status = 'pending' ORDER BY created_at LIMIT 50"},{"type":"exec","sql":"UPDATE mes_erp_outbox SET status = 'simulated', processed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE status = 'pending'"},{"type":"map","var":"rows","source":"${pending}","fields":{"outboxId":"${item.outbox_id}","entityType":"${item.entity_type}","entityId":"${item.entity_id}","idempotencyKey":"${item.idempotency_key}","status":"simulated"}},{"type":"return","fields":{"error_code":"OK","error_message":"","rows":"${rows}"}}]}

{"steps":[{"type":"selectOne","var":"row","sql":"SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS VARCHAR(16)) AS asset_count, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN freshness <> 'fresh' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS VARCHAR(16)) AS stale_count FROM mes_exec_asset WHERE site_code = ?","params":["${input.siteCode}"]},{"type":"setVar","var":"status","value":"ready"},{"type":"if","var":"row.asset_count","equals":"0","then":[{"type":"setVar","var":"status","value":"empty"}]},{"type":"if","var":"row.stale_count","notEquals":"0","then":[{"type":"if","var":"row.asset_count","notEquals":"0","then":[{"type":"setVar","var":"status","value":"partial"}]}]},{"type":"return","fields":{"error_code":"OK","error_message":"","status":"${status}","staleCount":"${row.stale_count}","assetCount":"${row.asset_count}"}}]}

{"steps":[{"type":"selectMany","var":"assets","sql":"SELECT asset_id, display_name, freshness, status, source_name FROM mes_exec_asset WHERE site_code = ? ORDER BY asset_id","params":["${input.siteCode}"]},{"type":"map","var":"rows","source":"${assets}","fields":{"assetId":"${item.asset_id}","displayName":"${item.display_name}","freshness":"${item.freshness}","status":"${item.status}","sourceName":"${item.source_name}"}},{"type":"return","fields":{"error_code":"OK","error_message":"","rows":"${rows}"}}]}

{"steps":[{"type":"selectMany","var":"resources","sql":"SELECT resource_id, resource_type, CAST(qty AS VARCHAR(32)) AS qty, CAST(reserved_qty AS VARCHAR(32)) AS reserved_qty, CAST(qty - reserved_qty AS VARCHAR(32)) AS free_qty, data_status, quality_status, freshness FROM mes_exec_resource WHERE site_code = ? ORDER BY resource_id","params":["${input.siteCode}"]},{"type":"map","var":"rows","source":"${resources}","fields":{"resourceId":"${item.resource_id}","resourceType":"${item.resource_type}","qty":"${item.qty}","reservedQty":"${item.reserved_qty}","freeQty":"${item.free_qty}","dataStatus":"${item.data_status}","qualityStatus":"${item.quality_status}","freshness":"${item.freshness}"}},{"type":"return","fields":{"error_code":"OK","error_message":"","rows":"${rows}"}}]}

{"steps":[{"type":"exec","sql":"UPDATE mes_exec_resource SET data_status = 'confirmed', freshness = 'fresh', owner_role = ?, comment_text = ? {"steps":[{"type":"selectOne","var":"existing","sql":"SELECT reserve_id FROM mes_exec_reserve WHERE reserve_id = ?","params":["${input.reserveId}"]},{"type":"if","var":"existing.reserve_id","notNull":true,"then":[{"type":"return","fields":{"error_code":"OK","error_message":"","reserveId":"${input.reserveId}","status":"already_reserved"}}]},{"type":"selectOne","var":"gate","sql":"SELECT quality_status, data_status, CASE WHEN (qty - reserved_qty) >= ? WHERE resource_id = ?","params":["${input.qty}","${input.resourceId}"]},{"type":"exec","sql":"INSERT INTO mes_exec_reserve (reserve_id, resource_id, pub_id, qty) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)","params":["${input.reserveId}","${input.resourceId}","${input.pubId}","${input.qty}"]},{"type":"return","fields":{"error_code":"OK","error_message":"","reserveId":"${input.reserveId}","status":"reserved"}}]}

{"steps":[{"type":"selectOne","var":"hold","sql":"SELECT reserve_id, resource_id, CAST(qty AS VARCHAR(32)) AS qty FROM mes_exec_reserve WHERE reserve_id = ?","params":["${input.reserveId}"]},{"type":"if","var":"hold","notNull":false,"then":[{"type":"return","fields":{"error_code":"OK","error_message":"","status":"already_released"}}]},{"type":"exec","sql":"UPDATE mes_exec_resource SET reserved_qty = reserved_qty - ? WHERE resource_id = ?","params":["${hold.qty}","${hold.resource_id}"]},{"type":"exec","sql":"DELETE FROM mes_exec_reserve WHERE reserve_id = ?","params":["${input.reserveId}"]},{"type":"return","fields":{"error_code":"OK","error_message":"","status":"released"}}]}

{"steps":[{"type":"exec","sql":"INSERT INTO mes_exec_inbox (message_id, message_type, idempotency_key, payload_json, status) SELECT ?, 'IF-04', ?, ?, 'received' WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mes_exec_inbox WHERE idempotency_key = ?)","params":["${input.candidateId}","${input.idempotencyKey}","${input.candidateId}","${input.idempotencyKey}"]},{"type":"exec","sql":"INSERT INTO mes_exec_candidate (candidate_id, site_code, sku_code, planned_qty, uom, quality_status, validation_status, validation_message, idempotency_key) SELECT ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 'received', '', ? ORDER BY created_at","params":["${input.siteCode}"]},{"type":"map","var":"rows","source":"${cands}","fields":{"candidateId":"${item.candidate_id}","skuCode":"${item.sku_code}","plannedQty":"${item.planned_qty}","qualityStatus":"${item.quality_status}","validationStatus":"${item.validation_status}"}},{"type":"return","fields":{"error_code":"OK","error_message":"","rows":"${rows}"}}]}
